# Jobs of .github/workflows/ci.yml that run on every pull request but are NOT part of the gate `ci`
# (continue-on-error, not in the gate's needs). One job name per line, exactly as GitHub shows it
# (the job's `name:`). Lines starting with # and empty lines are ignored.
#
# Read by .github/scripts/already-tested.sh: a red informational job does not stop main from taking
# over the result of a pull-request run, because the gate does not ask for it either. Checked by
# server/tools/ciworkflows (task ci:workflows): every job is either in the gate's needs or listed
# here with continue-on-error, never both.
